drivingQuestion: Why does the second confession, not the first, include 'the children of Aaron'?

segments.he: בָּא לוֹ אֵצֶל פָּרוֹ שְׁנִיָּה. מַאי שְׁנָא בְּוִידּוּי רִאשׁוֹן דְּלָא אָמַר: ״וּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן עַם קְדוֹשֶׁךָ״, וּמַאי שְׁנָא בְּוִידּוּי שֵׁנִי דְּאָמַר: ״וּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן עַם קְדוֹשֶׁךָ״?
segments.en: The mishna states: The High Priest «comes» and stands «next to his bull a second» time and confesses: Please God, I have sinned…I and my family and the children of Aaron, your sacred people. The Gemara asks: «What is different about the first confession» that he made over the bull, in «which he did not say: And the children of Aaron, your sacred people, and what is different about the second confession» in «which he said: And the children of Aaron, your sacred people?»
